stemMarkdown: 20 litres of a 25% acid solution is mixed with 10 litres of a 60% acid solution. What is the acid concentration (in %) of the resulting mixture? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Acid from the first: $5.00$ L. From the second: $6.00$ L. Total acid $= 11.00$ L in $30$ L of mixture, so the concentration is $36.67\%$.
